welcome.description: We're glad to have you in our app! Here you'll find all the tools you need for productive work and easy task management.
featureList: Work more effectively with your team
welcome.featureListTitle: All your productivity tools in a single platform:
welcome.title: Welcome!

landing.title: Track every minute — without spreadsheets
landing.subtitle: A focused time-tracking app with a central timer, activities, analytics, calendar, and history — so you know where your day went.

features.title: Unified stopwatch
features.body: Start, pause, and finish sessions from the main timer and activity cards — the numbers stay aligned.

features.title: Activities & today’s board
features.body: Create reusable activities with tags, run them alongside your day plan, and keep unfinished sessions under control.

features.title: Calendar view
features.body: See sessions on the grid and skim how time distributes across dates.

features.title: Histories
features.body: Grouped history by day lets you revisit past intervals and reopen details without digging through spreadsheets.

features.title: Per-activity analytics
features.body: Day timeline, session breakdown, and durations so you spot patterns and outliers.

features.title: Account & profile
features.body: Sign in securely, tweak profile text, theme, language, and notifications from one place.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern your use of our time-tracking application and related services. Please read them carefully.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body:
By creating an account, signing in, or otherwise using the Service, you confirm that you are at least the age of majority in your jurisdiction and that you agree to comply with these Terms.

If you use the Service on behalf of an organization, you represent that you have authority to bind that organization to these Terms.

sections.heading: 2. Description of the Service
sections.body:
The Service helps you record and analyze time spent on activities. Features may change over time.

We strive to maintain availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation.

sections.heading: 3. Accounts and Security
sections.body:
You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activity under your account.

Notify us promptly of any unauthorized access or security incident.

sections.heading: 4. Acceptable Use
sections.body:
You agree not to misuse the Service—for example by attempting to disrupt systems, scrape data without permission, reverse engineer beyond what the law permits, upload malware, harass others, or violate applicable laws.

We may suspend or terminate access if we reasonably believe you have breached these Terms or pose a risk to the Service or other users.

sections.heading: 5. Intellectual Property
sections.body:
The Service and its content (excluding your data that you submit) remain our intellectual property.

You retain ownership of the data you provide. By using the Service, you grant us a limited license to host, store, process, and display your data solely to operate and improve the Service as described in our Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 6. Disclaimers and Limitation of Liability
sections.body:
The Service is provided “as is” and “as available” without warranties of any kind to the fullest extent permitted by law.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, our liability for disputes arising out of these Terms or the Service is limited to amounts you paid us in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, or one hundred USD (USD 100), whichever is greater—or the maximum permitted in your jurisdiction if lower.

sections.heading: 7. Changes and Termination

We may modify the Service or these Terms. For material changes, we will provide notice where legally required—you should review updates periodically.

You may stop using the Service at any time. Some provisions survive termination—including limitations of liability, disclaimers where applicable, and governing law—as reasonable under law.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and safeguard information when you use our Service. By using the Service, you acknowledge the practices described here.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body:
We collect information that you voluntarily provide—for example account details (such as login or email where applicable), activity names and time entries that you generate, and support communications.

We automatically collect limited technical information needed to operate the Service (such as logs, approximate device/browser type, and timestamps) consistent with ordinary web and mobile analytics.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Information
sections.body:
We use information to deliver and secure the Service, authenticate users, troubleshoot issues, analyze usage trends in aggregate form, comply with legal obligations, and communicate with you about updates or incidents.

We do not sell your personal information for money as traditionally defined; we process data solely to operate the Service unless otherwise stated or required by law.

sections.heading: 3. Legal Bases
sections.body:
Where applicable privacy laws apply, we rely on bases such as: performance of a contract (providing the Service), legitimate interests (security and improving the Service, balanced against your rights), consent where requested, or legal obligation.

You may withdraw consent where processing depends on consent, subject to contractual or legal exceptions.

sections.heading: 4. Sharing & Processors
sections.body:
We may engage service providers (“processors”) hosting infrastructure or analytics pursuant to contractual safeguards.

We may disclose information if required by law or to protect rights, safety, security, or the integrity of the Service.

sections.heading: 5. Retention & Security
sections.body:
We retain personal data only as long as necessary for purposes described herein, including legal, security, accounting, backup, or dispute resolution needs.

We implement commercially reasonable safeguards; no transmission or storage method is guaranteed 100% secure.

sections.heading: 6. Your Rights
sections.body:
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, or object to processing, and may lodge complaints with supervisory authorities.

To exercise applicable rights or ask questions about this Policy, please contact us through the contacts provided within the Service or documentation.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to This Policy
sections.body:
We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Updates will indicate a new revision date.

Where materially required under law or our practices change significantly, we will provide additional notice or obtain consent consistent with regulatory expectations.
